description: p-1's hold waits in awaiting_pickup while the hold_queue chart is edited in idle only: idle's copy.available condition is rewritten from pending > 0 to pending >= 1. The diff compares a condition by its text, so the pair is breaking; but awaiting_pickup's own transitions and onexit are byte-identical in both charts, so at this position the predicate answers true. A breaking pair can be harmless to one execution.
